sentences.text:
?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:238638
Court No. - 70

Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 54002 of 2023
Applicant :- Sangam Lal @ Mithilesh

Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Applicant :- Brijesh Kumar,Abhishek Kumar Saroj,Amardeo Singh
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State apprised the Court that notice has been served upon the informant on 09.12.2023.
Despite service of notice, none present on behalf of the informant.

2. Heard Sri Amardeo Singh, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned AGA for the State.
3. The instant bail application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 371 of 2023, under Sections 376, 452, 506 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station Koraon, District Prayagraj during pendency of the trial.
4. FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant on 10.09.2023 and according to the FIR on 28.08.2023 applicant after entering in the house of the informant committed rape with the daughter Sangam Lal @ Mithilesh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24615096/
1 of the informant aged about 16 years.
5. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that entire allegation made against the applicant is totally false and baseless and FIR of the present case was lodged after two weeks and this inordinate delay in lodging the FIR itself suggests that applicant has falsely been implicated in the present matter.
6.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
He further submits that however victim in her both the statements recorded under Sections 161 Cr.P.C. and 164 Cr.P.C. made allegation of rape against the applicant but from her both the statements it reflects that very casually she implicated the applicant in such a heinous offence of rape and no reliance can be placed on such statement.
7.
He further submits that actually applicant and informant were having inimical terms due to village party bandi and only due to this reason, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.

8. He further submits that as per school record victim was fourteen and half years old but according to CMO concerned at the time of incident she was of 17 years, therefore, precisely it cannot be said that victim is below 18 years.
9. He further submits that applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 12.09.2023.
10. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail but could not dispute the argument on facts advanced by learned counsel for the applicant.
11. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

12. However, from the school record, it reflects that at the time of incident victim was about fourteen and half years but according to CMO concerned her radiological age was about 17 years, therefore, I find force in the argument advanced by learned counsel for the applicant that at this stage precisely it cannot be said that victim at the time of incident was below 18 years.

13. Further, however, victim in her both the statements recorded during investigation made allegation of rape against the applicant but her statements recorded during investigation does not appear to be convincing and it appears that very casually she made allegation of rape against the applicant.
14. Further, applicant is not having any criminal history and in the present matter he is in jail since 12.09.2023.

15. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.

sentences.text: Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

17. Let the applicant - Sangam Lal @ Mithilesh be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.
(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.
18. In case of breach of any of the above condition, the prosecution will be at liberty to move an application before this Court for cancellation of the bail of the applicant.

19. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
Order Date :- 16.12.2023 AK Pandey  Sangam Lal @ Mithilesh vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 16 December, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/24615096/
